clips.send: A friend afraid to quit a wrong path sends this in anxiety about being seen as a failure
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says most people quit a path and call it failure, when really they just learned something new. You got excited about a job or a business, went for it, then it stopped feeling right.

That is not a mistake. You went as far as you could see, and now you can see further. With new information, you get to make a new decision - that is not quitting, that is growing.

Stop punishing yourself for outgrowing a goal you already outgrew.

clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says your brain works like a tuning fork. Put it in a room with ten broke, negative people on the poverty wave, and resistance is futile - your brain starts matching their frequency whether you want it to or not.

That is why the people you stand next to decide more than you think. Growing up blue collar surrounds you with a ceiling on what you believe is possible.

Change the room, and you change the frequency.

clips.start_words: Example, when I was growing up
clips.send: A friend mocked for a big dream sends this in anger at being told to shrink it
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says when he was growing up, dreaming big got him laughed at. Friends told him who does he think he is, you're just like us, you're never going to be a millionaire.

Here is why that happens: people who are broke do not want you to succeed, because if you go above them, they feel left behind. Consciously or not, misery loves company.

The friends who laugh the loudest are usually the ones most afraid to try.

Comment BRAIN and I'll send you the 14 audios that help you dream past the room you grew up in.

#kevintrudeau #mindset #richmindset #success #lawofattraction #selfimprovement

clips.send: A parent sends this to a kid who stopped dreaming big, in awe that it's still possible
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says every kid dreams impossible things without a second thought. You wanted to be Wonder Woman, or Spider-Man climbing a wall - and some part of you could see it.

That is proof your mind can hold a dream your logic calls impossible. The ability never left. Somewhere along the way, you decided dreaming that big was only for kids.

Give yourself permission to dream that size again, on purpose, about something real.

Comment WISH and I'll send you the 14 audios that help you dream big again.
